# googleworkspace_chrome_group_policy (Resource)

Chrome Policy resource for a group in the Terraform Googleworkspace provider. Only policy schemas that support groups can be set on a group: the API supports group targets only for the policies of apps (`chrome.users.apps.*`), printers (`chrome.printers.*`), and print servers (`chrome.printerservers.*`). These policies need `additional_target_keys`, for example `app_id` or `printer_id`. When more than one group sets the same policy, `googleworkspace_chrome_policy_group_priority_ordering` sets which group has priority. Chrome Policy Schema resides under the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chrome.management.policy` client scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "googleworkspace_group" "chrome_pilot" {
  email = "chrome-pilot@example.com"
}

# Force-install an extension for the members of a group.
resource "googleworkspace_chrome_group_policy" "docs_offline" {
  group_id = googleworkspace_group.chrome_pilot.id

  additional_target_keys {
    target_key   = "app_id"
    target_value = "chrome:ghbmnnjooekpmoecnnnilnnbdlolhkhi"
  }

  policies {
    schema_name = "chrome.users.apps.InstallType"
    schema_values = {
      appInstallType = jsonencode("FORCED")
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the target group on which this policy is applied.
- `policies` (Block List, Min: 1) Policies to set for the group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--policies))

### Optional

- `additional_target_keys` (Block Set) Additional target keys that identify the target of all policies in this resource, for example `app_id` for the policies of an app (`chrome.users.apps.*`). Each `target_key` can occur only once. To set the policies of more than one app, use one resource for each app. Changing this forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--additional_target_keys))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `applied_values` (Map of String) The values that the API stored for a policy after the last write, by schema name, when they differ from the configured values (for example, values that the API normalized). The provider sets this attribute. While the API values and the configured values do not change, the plan shows no change for these policies.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Required:

- `schema_name` (String) The full qualified name of the policy schema.
- `schema_values` (Map of String) JSON encoded map that represents key/value pairs that correspond to the given schema.


<a id="nestedblock--additional_target_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `additional_target_keys`

Required:

- `target_key` (String) The name of the target key, for example `app_id`.
- `target_value` (String) The value of the target key, for example `chrome:ghbmnnjooekpmoecnnnilnnbdlolhkhi`.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# The API supports group targets only for app, printer, and print server policies. These need additional target keys.

# <group_id>/<key>=<value>[+<key>=<value>...]/<schema names, separated by commas>
terraform import googleworkspace_chrome_group_policy.docs_offline 01abcde23fg4h5i/app_id=chrome:ghbmnnjooekpmoecnnnilnnbdlolhkhi/chrome.users.apps.InstallType

# A printer policy.
terraform import googleworkspace_chrome_group_policy.printer 01abcde23fg4h5i/printer_id=0gjdgxs1a2b3c4d/chrome.printers.AllowForUsers
```
